| Increases for tax positions related to the current year | -      | -      |
| Increases for tax positions related to prior years      | -      | 2      |
| Decreases for tax positions due to expiring statutes    | (89)   | (47)   |
| Balance, end of year                                    | $ 24   | $ 113  |

Our unrecognized tax benefit is related to research and development credits taken on our U.S. income tax returns for 2017 and the uncertainty related to the realization of a portion of those credits based on prior experience. We believe it reasonably possible that we will not recognize any of our unrecognized tax benefits at least through December 31, 2021. If we realized and recognized any of our unrecognized tax benefits such benefits would reduce our effective tax rate in the year of recognition.

We record interest and penalty expense related to income taxes as interest and other expense, respectively. At December 31, 2019, no interest or penalties have been or are required to be accrued. Our open tax years are 2016 and forward for our federal income tax returns and 2015 and forward for most of our state income tax returns. We do not file, and are not required to file, any foreign income tax returns.
